referenceOnly.label: CMSX-4 reference only (not IN718, not used for any band)

sets.caveat: Calibrated for electron-beam melting and transferred to LPBF without an LPBF fit. LPBF powder, nucleant density, gradients and remelting differ, so treat the band as an indication only.
sets.citation: A. Knapp et al., Additive Manufacturing 25 (2019) 511-521 (EB-PBF IN718, CET criterion calibrated to a casting solidification map)
sets.label: Knapp 2019, IN718 EB-PBF (calibrated to a casting map)
sets.note: N0 is the nucleant density used for the casting-map calibration, not an LPBF measurement.
sets.phiSource: Hunt 1984 critical values as used in Knapp 2019 p. 514; limits printed p. 515
sets.verifiedBy: Printed G^2R limits reproduced: 1.52e11 at phi 0.0066 and 6.98e9 at phi 0.49 (p. 515).

sets.caveat: Calibrated for electron-beam melting and transferred to LPBF without an LPBF fit. LPBF powder, nucleant density, gradients and remelting differ, so treat the band as an indication only.
sets.citation: M. Polonsky et al., 2020 (EBM IN718, IMS-fitted CET constants, N0 from counted grains)

N0.locator: Sec 3.3, Table 2 (206 grains in 38.4 nL; the paper calls it a lower bound)

a.locator: Sec 3.3, Eq. 5, Table 2 (paper prints the unit as m s/K^n, a typo; Eq. 5 needs K^n s/m)

sets.equationLocator: Polonsky 2020 Sec 3.3, Eq. 4 (Gaumann form) and Eq. 5
sets.label: Polonsky 2020, IN718 EBM (IMS-fitted, N0 from grain counts)
sets.note: N0 is a lower bound from counted grains, so the equiaxed boundary sits at lower G than a larger N0 would give.
sets.phiSource: Hunt 1984 via Knapp 2019 p. 514; not stated by Polonsky 2020

equationRead.locator: Polonsky 2020 Sec 3.3, Eq. 4 (Gaumann form) and Eq. 5

cet.note: Nucleation undercooling dTn is neglected in this form. The model is single-component-like: multicomponent solutal effects are not in the equation. N0 (nucleant density) depends on the process and powder and is not a material constant. Screening only; not a grain-structure prediction.

GA01.citation: M. Gäumann, C. Bezençon, P. Canalis, W. Kurz, Acta Mater. 49 (2001) 1051-1062 (single-crystal laser deposition of CMSX-4; CET model)

H84.citation: J. D. Hunt, Mater. Sci. Eng. 65 (1984) 75-83 (steady-state columnar and equiaxed growth of dendrites and eutectic)

KN19.citation: A. Knapp et al., Additive Manufacturing 25 (2019) 511-521 (EB-PBF IN718, CET criterion calibrated to a casting solidification map)

PO20.citation: M. Polonsky et al., 2020 (EBM IN718, IMS-fitted CET constants, N0 from counted grains)
